meta.name: Kappi Squad
meta.description: Four emotionally unfinished young adults turn their insecurit ego and wounded pride into an unlikely café business. How will these four go for validation?

videos.title: Hangover
videos.overview: Kiran struggles with his boss. Anu wants to quit her job. It is Pappi's first day at work after his stint in the seminary. But a New Year's Eve party changes everything.

videos.title: The First and Last Sip
videos.overview: As Vijay closes his coffee shop, the squad loses an important part of their lives. Their old memories and love stories resurface.

videos.title: Grandma and the Birthday Party
videos.overview: Kiran's birthday is overshadowed by his grandmother's birthday celebration. As Anu's job isn't enough to survive in Kochi, the squad enters a competition to win Grandma's gift.

videos.title: Mission: Best Coffee
videos.overview: Kiran takes up Anu's challenge to make the perfect coffee that matches Vijay's coffee. Slowly, it turns into an obsession.

videos.title: The Coffee Hunt
videos.overview: Kiran's obsession with making the perfect coffee spirals into madness. Meanwhile, Anu and Pappi set out to find a replacement for Captain Tea Stall.

videos.title: The Café Dream
videos.overview: Kiran desperately tries to convince Anu to start a café with him. On the other side, Pappi goes on a date with Isha's help.

videos.title: Hidden Secrets
videos.overview: Kiran secretly sells his car to fund his café dream, hiding the truth from Anu. Pappi goes shopping with Maya without Isha’s knowledge. But secrets never stay hidden for long.

videos.title: Car and Café
videos.overview: Kiran and Anu set out to deliver the car to its buyer. Meanwhile, Pappi and Isha are tasked with learning what it takes to run a café.

videos.title: Light, Camera, Coffee
videos.overview: Kiran's father is shooting for a coffee ad. The squad goes to convince him to invest in the café. Will they succeed?

videos.title: Worst Coffee Experience
videos.overview: The squad finds the perfect place to start their café. But first, they must convince its eccentric owner to rent it to them.

videos.title: Childhood Friend and the Groom
videos.overview: Kiran's college friend arrives to design the café interiors. Meanwhile, Anu's prospective groom pays her a visit.

videos.title: Barista Arrives
videos.overview: As the café dream slowly becomes a reality, the squad begins the search for a barista. Meanwhile, the fight between Kiran and Anu continues to grow.

videos.title: Purchase Showdown
videos.overview: As Kiran and Anu argue over which espresso machine to buy, the barista puts them to the test. It's a battle to see who can purchase more efficiently for the café.

videos.title: Investor Troubles
videos.overview: The café is almost ready, but Kiran's money has run out. With opening day approaching, the squad begins searching for an investor. But an unexpected person visits the café.

videos.title: Damage Control
videos.overview: With the café depending on an investor, Kiran is left to face the biggest meeting alone. Meanwhile, Anu has a difficult conversation with her father after he finds out about Kiran.

videos.title: Café and Chaos
videos.overview: The café reaches its inauguration day, but preparations are far from smooth. Between family expectations, a missing celebrity, a troubled espresso machine, chaos takes over.

videos.title: New Problems
videos.overview: A priest and a Vastu expert clash under the café's roof, sending the business into chaos. Can Kiran keep things under control before the damage becomes irreversible?

videos.title: Hiring Staff
videos.overview: When Pappi learns the café is hiring his replacement, he starts sabotaging every applicant. But what happens when one candidate proves too clever for him?

videos.title: Don't Pray
videos.overview: Pappi's prayers bring a sudden rush of customers, leaving Kiran convinced that a miracle has happened. But his happiness fades when he spots a familiar face among the newcomers.

videos.title: Varun's Vision
videos.overview: Kiran's brother Varun launches a costume party to attract new customers. Will his big idea save the café or turn into a costly disaster?

videos.title: Salary Day
videos.overview: On the café's first payday, everyone's dreams depend on their wages. As Isha turns the occasion into content, the team discovers that the numbers tell a different story.

videos.title: Best of Luck
videos.overview: Kiran blames Pappi for bringing bad luck, but a lottery ticket becomes his last hope of securing money for the café. Who is really unlucky?

videos.title: Father's Visit
videos.overview: Kiran takes over as barista and tries to prove himself with a special coffee. But an unexpected visitor arrives, turning an ordinary day into a test he never prepared for.

videos.title: Angel Is Back
videos.overview: While Roshan arrives at the café for a date, Anjana heads to an audition hoping for her big break. But both encounters take unexpected turns.
